scope: Private ordinary Linux library/backend prototype in isolated offline x86-64 WHPX guests. Both one-case attempts failed. This evidence establishes neither a supported installation nor a successful ordinary backend path, release readiness, performance, or parity.

build_and_revalidation.linked_attempt: The original Rust LTO link command returned 0 and exported artifact bytes. The aggregate linked attempt failed an after-link authority check that expected a root-owned file for a user-owned Rust host library and rejected it before the post-link hash read and remains failed.
build_and_revalidation.read_only_followup: A later independent read-only check matched both retained ELF byte sequences and two scoped compiler-library files. It did not rerun the link or change the failed original.

attempts.observed: Payload readiness bytes survived. The guest fixture failed and fallback reported retirement. No qualifying serial frame or verified native outcome survived. The old witness combined a requirement for group 0 with a live-population check and recorded neither conjunct independently, leaving its original failure branch unproven.

The corrected witness accepted the original live leaf after checking root ownership, group equality to the held original watchdog and caller, no group or other write bits, and one populated-1 row. The containing cgroup kept the stricter root ownership and group rule. The host received the explicit failure transport. Fallback retirement was separately reported, with no qualified unassisted pass.

diagnosis: A reachable source race can prevent delivery of a valid kernel-generated SCM_PIDFD if the watchdog consumes the original reaper wait before the caller receives the queued retirement packet. The retained failed receipt cannot identify the exact rejected branch. A proposed acknowledgment before consuming the original wait has design review only at this evidence point.
evidence_limit: The retained raw evidence remains private. Physical excerpts are bound to the original image and byte offsets without asserting a filesystem filename mapping. A complete public reproduction package remains open.
